How do I update my contact or account details?
You can’t directly change most core account details in-app, but here’s what you can do based on what we support:
Username changes: You need to contact our Support Team (via Help Center ticket or email from your registered address) and include your current username, email, and 2–3 new username options. Your account must have no active rentals, no open disputes, and be in good standing.
Tax/account details for HMRC reporting: If we email you requesting information (name, DOB, address, tax/NI number, or business details), reply and submit the requested form as soon as possible so your account and payouts aren’t paused.
Account deletion: If you want to fully close your account, email us from the same email you used to sign up and request deletion.
Payment/verification setup: During sign-up you’ll be taken through Stripe to add your payment details and complete ID verification; Stripe also charges a small one-time verification fee for this.
If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.

You can’t directly “swap” the payment method on an existing order, but you can control which method is used before you complete checkout.

If you’ve got lending earnings, these are used as app credit by default.
To pay with a different method (like a card), first withdraw your available balance to your bank so your in‑app balance is £0.
With a zero balance, the app will then prompt you to add an alternative payment method at checkout for your next rental request.

Payments for rentals are then held and processed through our provider Stripe once the request is accepted and the rental is completed.
